name: platform-feature-fomo
definition: A brand-new platform update, algorithm change, or native feature that just dropped — watch or be left behind while early movers capitalize. The hook is the novelty and recency of the feature itself, not a tool you go acquire.
signals: Instagram just dropped the biggest cheat code
starting last week you can now
new update big creators are already using
you didn't even notice this new feature
the algorithm just changed and nobody's talking about it

name: fear-of-mistake
definition: You are unknowingly doing it wrong and sabotaging your own results — stop or fix this before it costs you more. The driver is loss-aversion and shame, framed around an error the viewer is already making.
signals: delete your highlights if they look like this
stop using hooks like this
this means your video sucks
you're doing way more harm than good
don't put anything here
the mistake killing your reach

name: hidden-lever-fix
definition: A concrete setting, toggle, or repeatable action you can pull right now for an outsized, usually free result — agency over an outcome that felt out of your hands. Prescriptive and actionable ('do X'), distinct from a vague money promise.
signals: never post until you fix these five settings
one simple setting doubles your views
go to settings then turn off
duplicate it as a trial reel
double the views all for free
do this every time before you post

name: shortcut-greed-money
definition: A fast, almost-cheating path to money, growth, or virality — a disproportionate dream result for minimal effort, framed as a hack or cheat code. The driver is greed/ease, not a specific reproducible setting.
signals: zero to a million dollars using AI
go from zero to a million followers in six months
pay for speed, it's a cheat code
make a fuck ton of money
got me millions of views for free
the lazy way to grow

name: gated-resource-tool
definition: A specific tool, prompt, template, or resource insiders use that you don't have yet — access is gated behind a comment/DM/follow, manufacturing want through exclusivity and a clear acquisition step.
signals: comment prompt and I'll send it
comment song for my library of 150 tracks
comment ready and I'll send you my exact prompt
I'll send you the template
what tool is this? grok / lovable / claude
link in bio to get the resource

name: curiosity-open-loop
definition: An unresolved question, guessing game, A/B reveal, or withheld answer you must keep watching to close. The driver is pure information gap, not a promised outcome or opinion.
signals: which video got more views, A or B?
sweet, but why?
what's the 50-to-fix-it rule?
guess the AI tool... you got it
the reveal at the end
wait for it

name: authority-formula-credibility
definition: A definitive expert breakdown, system, ranking, or framework backed by proven results, framed as the insider truth ('the X types', 'the perfect formula'). The driver is credibility and structure, not novelty or controversy.
signals: this got me over a million views
there are five main types of content
the perfect pin-post formula
the format that always goes viral is X
my clients and I do this
the seven main components

name: controversy-hot-take
definition: A polarizing, contrarian claim that challenges consensus and pressures you to pick a side or react. The driver is disagreement and tribal reaction, signaled by a stated stance against a popular belief.
signals: ChatGPT is dying a slow death
is university still worth it? no
hashtags are dead
dropshipping pass, automation cash
why are Gen Z kids so fragile
school is just consumption

name: aspiration-dream-result
definition: Vividly painting the dream lifestyle or end-state you want, then positioning the content as the bridge to it. The driver is pull toward a desirable future identity, not loss, ease, or a specific tactic.
signals: you're coming out the other end a weapon
creators are going to take over the world
go live in Bali
best shape of your life
go viral time and time again
growing your brand has never been easier

name: relatability-validation
definition: Naming the viewer's exact struggle, identity, or inner monologue so they feel seen ('that's me'), prompting saves and shares through recognition. The driver is identification, not a fix, fear, or promise.
signals: you say you don't have anything to post
I scroll for hours to find ideas
most creators run out of observations
building your brand solo and never posting
I don't know who needs to hear this
if you're a business owner, this is for you
